name: Heise
verdict: Hannover media company in the Heise family’s Heise Gruppe. Nothing found.
note: Main sponsor of Hannover 96 since 2024-25. Rating note: none. Heise Medien GmbH & Co. KG is “a company of the Heise Gruppe” (its legal notice), whose shareholders are Ansgar Heise, Christian Heise and Ansgar Heise’s three daughters (heise-medien-ownership).
